app.name: KisanMitra AI
app.tagline: AI-Powered Multilingual Crop Advisory Assistant for Farmers

landing.hero_title: Smart Farming Guidance in Your Own Language
landing.hero_subtitle: Personalized, science-backed agricultural advisory tailored to your crop, soil, weather, and farm conditions. Reduce input costs and protect yields with AI.
landing.feature1_desc: Actionable nutrient schedules, irrigation strategies, and growth stage guidance calculated for your exact acreage.
landing.feature2_desc: Upload leaf or pest photos to receive immediate diagnosis, confidence ratings, and safe IPM treatment plans.
landing.feature3_desc: Full support in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, and Kannada with plain, farmer-friendly terms.
landing.feature4_desc: Zero banned chemicals. Strictly prioritizes cultural, biological, and CIB&RC registered safe controls.
